reads.note: Facebook Graph API v1 node, GET (default) on the container id with fields id,status,status_code and access_token in the query. Both status nodes ask about the same container id (the second reads the first status node's id), so one route answers both in turn: first the upload check, then the publish check

writeReplies.note: Graph API node, POST https://graph.facebook.com/v20.0/<instagram_business_account_id>/media?image_url=…&caption=…&access_token=… (the query parameters the template lists, no body); answers the container id. The account id and image URL are the overlay's fills for the template's placeholders
